escalation.rationale: Iran raises military alert to maximum level claiming imminent US strikes, Ukraine deploys new long-range Flamingo missile against Moscow-area refinery, and Houthi attack on Riyadh compounds multi-front Middle East escalation.

ticker_items: Ukraine's new Flamingo missile strikes Russian refinery near Moscow — Zelensky confirms.
Iran military alert at highest level; Tehran warns of 'painful' response to US strikes.
Houthis claim attack on 'sensitive' sites in Saudi capital Riyadh.
Putin's United Russia wins parliamentary supermajority; wartime mandate cemented.
US warns of rapid Middle East escalation; State Dept issues security alert.

eastern_europe.description: Ukraine deployed its new Flamingo long-range missile in a mass bombardment targeting a Russian oil refinery near Moscow, described by Zelensky as devastating.

middle_east.description: Houthi forces claimed a strike on 'sensitive' sites in the Saudi capital Riyadh, prompting US warnings of rapid regional escalation.

observers.description: US actively involved in strikes on Iran alongside Israel, with CENTCOM reporting facilitation of 1 billion barrels of oil through Hormuz in two months. Ambassador Waltz warned allies to enforce Iran sanctions or face consequences. Trump issued direct threats of regime elimination if Iran refuses a deal.

Iran has raised its military alert to the highest possible level, claiming intelligence of imminent US strikes. Tehran warned of a 'painful' response and continues to condition Hormuz reopening on deal compliance. Iran backs Houthi operations against Saudi Arabia.

Saudi Arabia is engaged in renewed civil war in Yemen against Houthi forces and suffered a Houthi missile strike on Riyadh. Qatar's PM warned of economic fallout from the broader US-Israel-Iran war affecting Gulf stability.

Qatar's PM warned of economic fallout from the US-Israel war on Iran and announced a major investment pivot away from the conflict zone. Qatar is urging Gulf unity for conflict resolution amid rising instability.

Pakistan's Interior Minister Naqvi visited Tehran for talks focusing on bilateral ties amid escalating West Asia tensions. Pakistan appears to be positioning itself as a diplomatic interlocutor without direct military involvement.

South Korean President Lee confirmed Seoul will not deploy troops to intervene militarily in the Iran conflict, while offering to facilitate US-North Korea dialogue. Seoul is carefully balancing alliance obligations against regional restraint.

Russia continues offensive operations in eastern Ukraine, advancing toward Sloviansk and Kramatorsk in Donetsk. United Russia won a supermajority in parliamentary elections, consolidating Putin's domestic political control for continued wartime governance. Ukraine struck a Moscow-region refinery with a new long-range missile.

financial.brent_crude: Declining (third session fall as Saudi supply fears ease despite Hormuz risks)
financial.notes: European refiners are turning to US crude and diesel as Saudi supply routes are disrupted, while US emergency oil reserves sit at their lowest level since 1982, raising concerns about strategic reserve buffer capacity.
